text: Hey can u proofread the newsletter intro before thurs?
Yeah, send it over
[link: newsletter intro draft]
Read it. Two typos in para 2 (teh, recieve) and a doubled "the" in the meetup line. Also check the spelling of Chapeltown in the last para
Actually no, you have it right. I misread. Ignore that one
Lol ok. Thanks, I'd missed the teh
The printer in the back room ate my sign-up sheets btw. Had to reprint all 40
Ugh. Did the jam clear or is it still doing it
Cleared I think. Fed it the spare paper slowly and it coughed up a bit of the sheet. Seems fine now
Can I see the revised intro before u send to the committee? Want to check the date line
Yes. Thu 3 Dec, 7pm, community room
Ok. That's the right day
Kettle's on
Still here lol. Did u get the calendar sorted for the 14th
Not yet. Two of the room bookings clash, I'll look in the morning
Morning. Looking at the rooms now
Community room is free on the 3rd. The clash is the library hall on the 14th, so I've moved the knitting group to the 12th
Oh good. Did they say yes
Not yet, emailed Dee. Her out of office says back Monday
Went for bread and the bakery on Harrogate Rd was shut, sign said back Mon. Got a ciabatta from the Co-op instead, which is fine
Ok that's a real loss
Calendar draft is in the folder. 14th just says TBC for the library hall
Ok. I'll check the sign-up sheets got counted right after lunch
Sheets are counted, all 40. One has a coffee ring on it, you want that one?
Lol yes. It's fine 👍
